answer: Proposal 'cutwater': voice equals max-flow from jury roots through a capacity-capped endorsement graph. Each account adds at most c units of edge capacity per epoch, only toward transacted peers; the ledger enforces the caps. A sybil swarm grows a glacier of internal edges, yet voice is at most c*k for k edges from honest accounts; a whisper of bought trust is the only way in. A published min-cut is the lantern: auditors see whose capacity leaks. Open attack: buying endorsements at scale; cost stays linear in purchased trust, so the defense holds only while honest rationing keeps k small.
